products.title: Rangers - White
products.description: The Rangers White tee by OUTTERSPACE elevates modern luxury streetwear through exceptional craftsmanship and bold frontier storytelling. Milled from 100% premium luxury heavyweight cotton and finished with reinforced precision stitching, this shirt delivers a structured drape that holds its form while remaining soft and breathable. The cut features an intentional boxy dropped-shoulder silhouette complemented by a shape-retaining ribbed mock neckline. Anchoring the piece in an authentic Western aesthetic, the front design showcases tactile Outterspace rope script lettering set directly above a mirrored illustration of cowboys riding rearing black steeds with lassos in hand. Every detail is rendered using high-density screen printing and advanced direct-to-garment techniques to ensure rich contrast, vivid color, and long-lasting durability without cracking or fading.

products.title: Noctra Flare Pant
products.description: The Noctra Flare Pants in Deep Black by OUTTERSPACE merge runway-inspired tailoring with elevated luxury streetwear. Crafted from 100% premium luxury heavyweight French terry cotton, this piece delivers a structured, substantial drape that holds its exaggerated bell flare while providing ultra-soft, breathable comfort throughout the day. Engineered to high textile standards with reinforced double-needle precision stitching along every seam, hem, and pocket edge, it ensures maximum durability and tear resistance. products.title: Equis Rodeo Shirt
products.description: The Equis Rodeo shirt in Crisp White by OUTTERSPACE reimagines vintage Americana resort wear for the SS26 Cowboy Series. Milled from lightweight, breathable luxury cotton twill, this piece delivers a structured, crisp drape that maintains its clean boxy shape while offering all day comfort in warmer climates. Constructed to exacting textile standards with reinforced precision stitching along every seam, hem, and pocket edge, it ensures superior longevity and tear resistance. The front features an artistic hand-sketched illustration of a smiling cowboy in full Western regalia holding a lasso, anchored by bold OUTTERSPACE Est. 1946 lettering and cursive Luxury branding against vivid terracotta accents. Across the back, a complementary hand-drawn graphic displays a pair of pink and sage green floral-embroidered cowboy boots. Every element is applied using advanced high-density, fade-resistant print techniques to ensure vibrant colors and fine pencil-stroke details stay sharp across repeated washes. Finished with an open camp collar, a seamless front button placket, a functional chest patch pocket, and relaxed elbow-length sleeves, this shirt delivers an elevated statement for modern warm-weather styling.

products.title: Admiral
products.description: The Admiral Cap in Black by OUTTERSPACE reimagines classic maritime silhouette design through an opulent haute couture lens. Crafted from premium heavyweight brushed wool felt, this structured sailor cap provides a firm, shape-retaining crown with exceptional texture and warmth. Engineered to high textile standards with tight precision stitching along every panel, brim, and band, it ensures long lasting durability and wear resistance. The front profile is embellished with a row of large, light-catching round crystal gems tracing along the structured brim band, accompanied by delicate white floral vine embroidery that gracefully branches upwards across the crown. The side is detailed with an engraved brass Outter nameplate set against a genuine leather strap patch for a refined heritage finish. Constructed with a structured curved visor, a smooth internal comfort lining, and a moisture-absorbing sweatband, this statement headwear piece effortlessly elevates contemporary luxury streetwear styling.

products.title: Outfield Mirage
products.description: The Outfield Mirage tee in Crisp White by OUTTERSPACE reimagines vintage collegiate sportswear through an elevated luxury lens. Red and royal blue contrast athletic stripes accent the sleeves, perfectly matched with red and white striped ribbing along the thick mock neckline and sleeve cuffs. Finished with an intentional boxy dropped-shoulder silhouette, this piece delivers an authentic blend of retro athletic heritage and refined contemporary streetwear.

products.title: The Entourage Pants
products.description: The Entourage flared pants in Sand by OUTTERSPACE bring together tailored runway craftsmanship and frontier storytelling. Constructed from 100% premium luxury heavyweight cotton denim twill, this piece delivers a structured, substantial drape that holds its exaggerated bell flare while providing breathable all day comfort. Engineered to rigorous textile manufacturing standards with reinforced double needle precision stitching along every seam, pocket, and hemline, it guarantees superior tear resistance and maximum durability. The right thigh features the exclusive OUTTERSPACE Cowboy Series 2026 insignia alongside the signature philosophy script reading It is discipline in motion dreams running without a solid ending. Lower on the right leg is an illustrative scene of a seasoned cowboy guiding a young rider on horseback, balanced on the left lower flare by a dynamic print of stampeding wild horses. Applied using advanced high density screen printing and direct to garment techniques, each visual element retains rich earthy tones and fine illustrative line work without cracking, fading, or peeling. Finished with classic curved front pockets, heavy duty belt loops, a branded metallic shank button, and an exaggerated flared leg opening that pools effortlessly over sneakers or platform boots, these trousers deliver an elevated luxury statement.

products.title: Starwave Cap
products.description: The Starwave Cap by OUTTERSPACE elevates luxury headwear through artisanal detailing and motorsport-inspired design. Crafted with a structured six-panel silhouette from premium heavyweight cotton canvas, this piece offers a durable, clean crown shape with reinforced precision stitching along every panel. The interior features a soft, moisture-wicking sweatband engineered for breathable all-day comfort. The side profile is defined by dynamic sky-blue wave paneling bordered by intricate, hand-applied pearl bead clusters and shimmering micro-studs that catch the light from every angle. On the front crown, dimensional 3D embroidery showcases the OUTTERSPACE Luxury Limited Garments crest, complete with collegiate stars and an ornate heritage globe emblem. Finished with a pre-curved brim and an adjustable premium leather back strap with an antiqued brass buckle, this statement accessory effortlessly fuses high-energy streetwear with bespoke craftsmanship.

products.title: Black Embellish Cowboy Shirt
products.description: The Black Embellish Cowboy Shirt by OUTTERSPACE combines bespoke tailoring with high fashion Western detailing. Crafted from a rich, textured heavyweight boucle wool blend, this piece delivers a structured, boxy drape that holds its form while providing warmth and refined comfort. Constructed with reinforced precision stitching along every hem, seam, and collar line, it is engineered for superior durability and long lasting wear. The garment is highlighted by an ornate front placket featuring alternating luxury hardware buttons, including polished pearls, crystal cut glass gems, and sunburst rhinestone studs. The spread collar is accented with embroidered silver cowboy boots, while clean OUTTERSPACE serif branding sits across the right chest. On the left chest, an embroidered artisan patch depicts a cowboy tending to his saddled horse, rendered with high density thread work designed to resist fraying or fading. Finished with a classic camp collar, cropped boxy hem, and relaxed elbow length sleeves, this statement piece delivers an elevated fusion of frontier grit and haute couture elegance.

products.title: Western Romance Shirt
products.description: The Western Romance short sleeve button down shirt by OUTTERSPACE brings together refined tailoring and surreal frontier storytelling for luxury streetwear. Finished with a functional chest pocket and an intentional boxy silhouette, this statement piece offers a bold artistic expression for elevated contemporary wardrobes.
